skill.name: dispatching-parallel-agents
skill.description: Guide AI coding assistants to split independent debugging or implementation work across parallel agents.
skill.summary: Dispatch focused agents for independent tasks and integrate their results safely.
skill.author: davila7

content.value_statement: Independent debugging tasks often waste time when handled one after another. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code assign focused agents, review results, and integrate fixes.
actual_capabilities: Identifies when tasks are independent enough for parallel work.
Shows how to scope one agent per test file or subsystem.
Provides prompt structure for focused agent assignments.
Explains how to review agent summaries before integration.
Highlights verification steps after parallel changes land.
Documents common mistakes that reduce agent effectiveness.
limitations: Does not run agents or execute automation by itself.
Requires the user to judge whether workstreams share state.
Does not resolve merge conflicts automatically.
Works best when failures already have clear files or subsystems.

use_cases.title: Split Test Failure Triage
use_cases.description: Assign separate agents to independent failing test files and compare their root cause summaries.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Refactor Follow-Up
use_cases.description: Send agents to inspect unrelated breakages after a large code change, then integrate verified fixes.

use_cases.title: Improve Coding Assistant Workflows
use_cases.description: Create repeatable prompts for parallel investigation without giving each agent too broad a scope.

prompt_templates.title: Check Parallel Fit
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these failures and decide whether they are independent enough for parallel agents. Group them by subsystem and list any shared state risks.

prompt_templates.title: Create Agent Assignments
prompt_templates.scenario: Build focused tasks for multiple agents.
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn these independent failures into one focused agent task per domain. Include scope, goal, constraints, and expected summary for each task.

prompt_templates.title: Review Agent Results
prompt_templates.scenario: Compare completed agent work before integration.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these agent summaries and changed areas. Identify conflicts, missing verification, and which fixes are ready to integrate.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Advanced Integration
prompt_templates.scenario: Coordinate several parallel fixes after a larger refactor.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an integration plan for these parallel agent outputs. Order the merges, define verification commands, and flag risks that require manual review.

output_examples.input: Three unrelated test files fail after a refactor.
output_examples.output: A plan with one agent assigned to each file, clear constraints, expected summaries, and a final full-suite verification step.

output_examples.input: Agents return fixes for separate subsystems.
output_examples.output: A review checklist covering conflicts, root cause quality, changed files, test evidence, and final integration order.

output_examples.input: A team is unsure whether to split debugging work.
output_examples.output: A decision summary that separates independent domains from shared-state issues that need one investigator.

best_practices: Dispatch agents only when domains are independent and well scoped.
Give each agent exact files, goals, constraints, and expected output.
Run a full verification pass after combining all agent changes.
anti_patterns: Do not send agents broad tasks like fixing all failures.
Do not split work when one fix may affect every failure.
Do not merge agent output without checking conflicts and tests.

faq.question: When should I use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it when two or more tasks are independent and can be investigated without shared state.

faq.question: Does this skill execute agents automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides a workflow and prompt patterns for environments that support agent dispatch.

faq.question: Can I use it for related failures?
faq.answer: Use caution. Related failures usually need one investigation first because one fix may change the others.

faq.question: What should each agent receive?
faq.answer: Each agent should receive one scope, one goal, clear constraints, and the expected summary format.

faq.question: How do I integrate the results?
faq.answer: Read each summary, check for conflicting edits, run the full test suite, and spot check important changes.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
